method: Unprofiled ABAB five blocks (10 sessions/build/scenario/rate), plus ten adjacent A/A pairs/build/scenario/rate; Event Timing via PerformanceObserver and scripting via CDP timeline trace; each ABAB and A/A action retains before/after load averages; empirical winner is marked only when median gap exceeds the larger within-build p95 A/A absolute-delta band for that metric.
